description.value: Fantacity Karaoke is an Asian restaurant with karaoke on Robson Street in downtown Vancouver, one of the city's busiest pedestrian and cycling corridors. The venue offers indoor dining and private karaoke rooms, making it an evening dining-and-entertainment destination rather than a quick cyclist fuel stop. Its Robson Street location places it near the downtown bike network.
